description: Creates a complete go-to-market (GTM) plan - launch goals, prioritized target segments, channel strategy with owners, messaging matrix by persona, launch timeline, sales enablement checklist, and 30/60/90-day success metrics. Use when planning a product launch or major feature release; expanding into a new market or segment; designing an enterprise sales play; choosing between product-led, sales-led, marketing-led, or channel-led motions; or turning a launch idea into a one-page plan.
